mapper.select: SELECT h.HOSP_CD AS hospcd, h.HOSP_NM AS hospnm, h.JOIN_DT AS joindt FROM TBL_HOSP_MST h WHERE h.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} LIMIT 1

SELECT cm.DATE_YM AS ym , COUNT(*) AS bills , COUNT(DISTINCT mm.PAT_ID) AS pats , COALESCE(SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS),0) AS admdays , COALESCE(SUM(mm.TOT_AMT),0) AS totamt , COALESCE(SUM(mm.CLAIM_AMT),0) AS claimamt , COALESCE(SUM(mm.SELF_AMT),0) AS selfamt FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY cm.DATE_YM ORDER BY cm.DATE_YM

SELECT cm.DATE_YM AS ym, cm.INSUR_TYPE AS insurtype , COALESCE(SUM(mm.TOT_AMT),0) AS totamt, COUNT(DISTINCT mm.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE mm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY cm.DATE_YM, cm.INSUR_TYPE ORDER BY cm.DATE_YM, cm.INSUR_TYPE

SELECT LEFT(p.MED_START,6) AS ym , LEFT(COALESCE(p.PAT_CLASS,'E'),1) AS cls , COUNT(DISTINCT p.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST p WHERE p.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND p.MED_START BETWEEN CONCAT(#{fromYm},'01') AND CONCAT(#{toYm},'31') GROUP BY LEFT(p.MED_START,6), LEFT(COALESCE(p.PAT_CLASS,'E'),1) ORDER BY ym, cls

SELECT x.ym , SUM(x.inflag) AS incnt , SUM(x.outflag) AS outcnt , ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN x.outflag = 1 THEN x.staydays END), 1) AS avgstay FROM ( SELECT a.jm, a.ipdt, a.twdt, m.ym , CASE WHEN a.ipdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inflag , CASE WHEN a.twdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS outflag , CASE WHEN a.twdt <> '' AND LENGTH(a.ipdt) = 8 AND LENGTH(a.twdt) = 8 THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(a.twdt,'%Y%m%d'), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 END AS staydays FROM (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS jm , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND t.JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT JOBYYMM AS ym FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm}) m ON (a.ipdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%') OR a.twdt LIKE CONCAT(m.ym,'%')) ) x WHERE x.inflag = 1 OR x.outflag = 1 GROUP BY x.ym ORDER BY x.ym
SELECT JOBYYMM AS ym, SUM(WEIGVAL) AS score FROM TBL_PAT_INDI WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY JOBYYMM ORDER BY JOBYYMM

SELECT h.ym , COUNT(*) AS hosps , ROUND(AVG(h.tot),0) AS avgtot , ROUND(AVG(h.tot / NULLIF(h.days,0)),0) AS avgperday , ROUND(AVG(h.pats),0) AS avgpats FROM (SELECT cm.HOSP_CD, cm.DATE_YM AS ym, SUM(mm.TOT_AMT) AS tot, SUM(mm.ADM_DAYS) AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT mm.PAT_ID) AS pats FROM TBL_MYOUNG_MST mm JOIN TBL_CHUNG_MST cm ON cm.HOSP_CD = mm.HOSP_CD AND cm.CLAIM_NO = mm.CLAIM_NO WHERE COALESCE(mm.DELYN,'') = '' AND cm.DATE_YM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY cm.HOSP_CD, cm.DATE_YM HAVING tot > 0) h GROUP BY h.ym ORDER BY h.ym

SELECT START_YY AS startyy, QTER_FLAG AS qterflag, PAT_COUNT AS patcount, DOC_COUNT AS doccount , NUR_COUNT AS nurcount, NUR_S_CNT AS nurscnt, PHAM_DAYS AS phamdays, GOAL_SCORE AS goalscore, HOSPGRADE AS hospgrade FROM TBL_GRADE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY START_YY DESC, QTER_FLAG DESC, UPD_DTTM DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(cm.DATE_YM) FROM TBL_CHUNG_MST cm WHERE cm.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(cm.DEL_YN,'') <> 'Y'
SELECT HOSP_CD AS hospcd, BED_CNT AS bedcnt, VAR_COST_DAY AS varcostday, NOTE AS note, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_CFG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_CFG (HOSP_CD, BED_CNT, VAR_COST_DAY, NOTE, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{bedCnt}, #{varCostDay}, #{note}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE BED_CNT = VALUES(BED_CNT), VAR_COST_DAY = VALUES(VAR_COST_DAY), NOTE = VALUES(NOTE), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.select: SELECT c.HOSP_CD AS hospcd, c.CAT_CD AS catcd, c.CAT_NM AS catnm, c.CAT_GB AS catgb, c.SORT_NO AS sortno, c.USE_YN AS useyn , CASE WHEN c.HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS own FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT c WHERE c.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} OR (c.HOSP_CD = '*' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT o WHERE o.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND o.CAT_CD = c.CAT_CD)) ORDER BY c.CAT_GB, c.SORT_NO, c.CAT_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_COST_CAT (HOSP_CD, CAT_CD, CAT_NM, CAT_GB, SORT_NO, USE_YN, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{catCd}, #{catNm}, #{catGb}, #{sortNo}, #{useYn}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CAT_NM = VALUES(CAT_NM), CAT_GB = VALUES(CAT_GB), SORT_NO = VALUES(SORT_NO), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND CAT_CD = #{catCd} AND HOSP_CD <> '*'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND CAT_CD = #{catCd}
SELECT CAT_CD AS catcd, AMT AS amt, MEMO AS memo, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT MAX(YYYYMM) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM < #{ym}

SELECT m.YYYYMM AS ym , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.CAT_GB = 'R' THEN m.AMT ELSE 0 END),0) AS extraamt , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.CAT_GB,'C') = 'C' THEN m.AMT ELSE 0 END),0) AS costamt FROM TBL_MIS_COST m LEFT JOIN TBL_MIS_COST_CAT c ON c.CAT_CD = m.CAT_CD AND c.HOSP_CD = (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_MIS_COST_CAT o WHERE o.HOSP_CD = m.HOSP_CD AND o.CAT_CD = m.CAT_CD) THEN m.HOSP_CD ELSE '*' END) WHERE m.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND m.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{fromYm} AND #{toYm} GROUP BY m.YYYYMM ORDER BY m.YYYYMM
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_COST (HOSP_CD, YYYYMM, CAT_CD, AMT, MEMO, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{ym}, #{catCd}, #{amt}, #{memo}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CHUNG_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND DATE_YM = #{ym} AND COALESCE(DEL_YN,'') <> 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(REG_DTTM) AS lastreg FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID) AS cnt, MAX(REG_DTTM) AS lastreg FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND MED_START LIKE CONCAT(#{ym},'%')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(UPD_DTTM) AS lastreg, SUM(WEIGVAL) AS score FROM TBL_PAT_INDI WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND JOBYYMM = #{ym}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_GRADE_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND START_YY = #{yy} AND QTER_FLAG = #{qt} AND ACTION_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_MIS_COST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND YYYYMM = #{ym}

SELECT CATE_CODE AS catecode, ORDER_SEQ AS orderseq, WEVALUE_NM AS wevaluenm , START_INDI AS startindi, END_INDI AS endindi, STD_SCORE AS stdscore, WE_VALUE AS wevalue FROM TBL_WEVALUE_MST WHERE CATE_CODE IN ('01','02','03') AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND #{today} BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT ORDER BY CATE_CODE, START_INDI

SELECT LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq, PAT_NM AS patnm, BIRTH6 AS birth6, GENDER AS gender, GUARD_NM AS guardnm, GUARD_REL AS guardrel, TEL AS tel , CONTACT_DT AS contactdt, CHANNEL AS channel, COND_MEMO AS condmemo, STAGE AS stage, PLAN_DT AS plandt, NEXT_DT AS nextdt, NEXT_MEMO AS nextmemo , ADMIT_DT AS admitdt, DISCH_DT AS dischdt, MATCH_YN AS matchyn, CLOSE_RSN AS closersn, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm, UPD_USER AS upduser FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND (STAGE <> '90' OR UPD_DTTM >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)) ORDER BY STAGE, COALESCE(NEXT_DT, '99999999'), CONTACT_DT DESC, LEAD_SEQ DESC

SELECT LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq, PAT_NM AS patnm, BIRTH6 AS birth6, STAGE AS stage, ADMIT_DT AS admitdt, DISCH_DT AS dischdt, MATCH_YN AS matchyn FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_LEAD (HOSP_CD, PAT_NM, BIRTH6, GENDER, GUARD_NM, GUARD_REL, TEL, CONTACT_DT, CHANNEL, COND_MEMO, STAGE, PLAN_DT, NEXT_DT, NEXT_MEMO, ADMIT_DT, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{patNm}, #{birth6}, #{gender}, #{guardNm}, #{guardRel}, #{tel}, #{contactDt}, #{channel}, #{condMemo}, #{stage}, #{planDt}, #{nextDt}, #{nextMemo}, #{admitDt}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET STAGE = #{stage}, CLOSE_RSN = #{closeRsn}, UPD_USER = #{userId} WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}

UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET STAGE = CASE WHEN STAGE < #{stage} THEN #{stage} ELSE STAGE END , ADMIT_DT = CASE WHEN COALESCE(ADMIT_DT,'') = '' THEN #{admitDt} ELSE ADMIT_DT END /* 빈 글자('')로 저장된 입원일도 채운다 — COALESCE 는 '' 를 값으로 본다(실측) */ , DISCH_DT = CASE WHEN #{dischDt} <> '' THEN #{dischDt} ELSE DISCH_DT END , MATCH_YN = 'Y' WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}
UPDATE TBL_MIS_LEAD SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_USER = #{userId} WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT l.LEAD_SEQ AS leadseq , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD l JOIN TBL_IPWON_INFO t ON t.HOSP_CD = l.HOSP_CD AND LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) = l.BIRTH6 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') = l.PAT_NM AND REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') >= l.CONTACT_DT WHERE l.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND l.USE_YN = 'Y' AND l.STAGE IN ('10','20','30','40','50') /* 50(퇴원 후)도 다시 본다 — 입원일이 비어 있던 줄을 채우기 위해(멱등) */ AND COALESCE(l.BIRTH6,'') <> '' GROUP BY l.LEAD_SEQ, REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') ORDER BY l.LEAD_SEQ, ipdt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_LEAD_LOG (LEAD_SEQ, HOSP_CD, LOG_DT, STAGE, MEMO, REG_USER) VALUES (#{leadSeq}, #{hospCd}, #{logDt}, #{stage}, #{memo}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_SEQ AS logseq, LOG_DT AS logdt, STAGE AS stage, MEMO AS memo, REG_USER AS reguser, REG_DTTM AS regdttm FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD_LOG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEAD_SEQ = #{leadSeq} ORDER BY LOG_SEQ DESC

SELECT CHANNEL AS channel, COUNT(*) AS leads , SUM(CASE WHEN STAGE IN ('40','50') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS admits FROM TBL_MIS_LEAD WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CONTACT_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} GROUP BY CHANNEL

SELECT a.jm AS birth6, a.nm AS patnm, a.ipdt, a.twdt , DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(a.twdt,'%Y%m%d'), STR_TO_DATE(a.ipdt,'%Y%m%d')) + 1 AS staydays , f.DONE_YN AS doneyn, f.DONE_DT AS donedt, f.RESULT_CD AS resultcd, f.MEMO AS memo , (SELECT MIN(REPLACE(REPLACE(r.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','')) FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO r WHERE r.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEFT(r.JUMINNO,6) = a.jm AND REGEXP_REPLACE(r.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') = a.nm AND REPLACE(REPLACE(r.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') > a.twdt) AS readmitdt FROM (SELECT LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6) AS jm, REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]','') AS nm , REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') AS ipdt , MAX(COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t.TEWONDT,'-',''),'/',''),'')) AS twdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO t WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND t.JOBYYMM >= #{fromYm} GROUP BY LEFT(t.JUMINNO,6), REGEXP_REPLACE(t.PATNAME,'[0-9]',''), REPLACE(REPLACE(t.IPWONDT,'-',''),'/','') HAVING twdt BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt}) a LEFT JOIN TBL_MIS_FOLLOW f ON f.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND f.BIRTH6 = a.jm AND f.IPWON_DT = a.ipdt AND f.TEWON_DT = a.twdt ORDER BY a.twdt DESC, a.nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_FOLLOW (HOSP_CD, BIRTH6, IPWON_DT, TEWON_DT, DONE_YN, DONE_DT, RESULT_CD, MEMO, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{birth6}, #{ipwonDt}, #{tewonDt}, #{doneYn}, #{doneDt}, #{resultCd}, #{memo}, #{userId}, #{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DONE_YN = VALUES(DONE_YN), DONE_DT = VALUES(DONE_DT), RESULT_CD = VALUES(RESULT_CD), MEMO = VALUES(MEMO), UPD_USER = VALUES(UPD_USER)
mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_SEQ AS notiseq, NAME AS name, ROLE_NM AS rolenm, EMAIL AS email, TEL AS tel, MAIL_YN AS mailyn, SMS_YN AS smsyn , AUTO_GB AS autogb, MIN_LEVEL AS minlevel, USE_YN AS useyn, UPD_DTTM AS upddttm FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} ORDER BY USE_YN DESC, NOTI_SEQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER (HOSP_CD, NAME, ROLE_NM, EMAIL, TEL, MAIL_YN, SMS_YN, AUTO_GB, MIN_LEVEL, USE_YN, REG_USER, UPD_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{name}, #{roleNm}, #{email}, #{tel}, #{mailYn}, #{smsYn}, #{autoGb}, #{minLevel}, #{useYn}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND NOTI_SEQ = #{notiSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NM AS name, COALESCE(EMAIL,'') AS email, COALESCE(USER_TEL,'') AS tel, MAIN_GU AS maingu FROM TBL_USER_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND COALESCE(ACTION_YN,'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(USE_YN,'Y') <> 'N' AND (COALESCE(EMAIL,'') <> '' OR COALESCE(USER_TEL,'') <> '') GROUP BY USER_NM, COALESCE(EMAIL,''), COALESCE(USER_TEL,''), MAIN_GU ORDER BY MAIN_GU, USER_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MIS_NOTI_LOG (HOSP_CD, CHANNEL, TO_ADDR, TO_NAME, SUBJECT, BODY, RESULT, ERR_MSG, SENT_BY, LEVEL_CNT) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{channel}, #{toAddr}, #{toName}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{result}, #{errMsg}, #{sentBy}, #{levelCnt})
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_SEQ AS logseq, CHANNEL AS channel, TO_ADDR AS toaddr, TO_NAME AS toname, SUBJECT AS subject, RESULT AS result, ERR_MSG AS errmsg , SENT_BY AS sentby, LEVEL_CNT AS levelcnt, DATE_FORMAT(SENT_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS sentdttm FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_LOG WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} ORDER BY LOG_SEQ DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT DISTINCT HOSP_CD FROM TBL_MIS_NOTI_USER WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND AUTO_GB IN ('D','W')
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TBL_MIS_NOTI_RUN (RUN_DT, RUN_HOST) VALUES (#{runDt}, #{runHost})
